boundaryRows.label: spam
boundaryRows.text: 【港口客服】登船资格异常，请打开陌生网页上传身份证并填写短信验证码，否则立即取消订单。

boundaryRows.text: A supposed cruise desk says your boarding status failed and asks you to upload ID and enter an SMS code at a new link.

boundaryRows.text: A fake airline agent claims the refund failed and demands your online-banking password and one-time code to release it.

boundaryRows.text: A travel security center asks for passport, card details, and an SMS code on an unofficial link or claims you cannot board.

boundaryRows.label: spam
boundaryRows.text: 旅行安全センターを装い、非公式リンクで旅券・カード情報・SMSコードを入力しないと搭乗できないと脅しています。
